_comment: Source data for docs/assets/perf/load-ratio-{light,dark}.svg, drawn by scripts/plot-perf.py.
p95 of gcm_decrypt(col) LIKE '%김%' divided by p95 of AES_DECRYPT(col) LIKE '%김%', measured in
the same sessions with the queries interleaved. 300,000 rows, 29,918 matching, MySQL 8.4.11,
GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runners, 2026-10-07. Copied from docs/perf.md (CI per-suite SQL
runs); change both together. Each run landed on its own hosted machine, so the ratio, not the
milliseconds, is what compares across runs.
